## Why This Is Asked

Tests understanding of real-time audio path design and cross-platform native modules for React Native, focusing on latency, backpressure, and lifecycle.

## Key Concepts

- Real-time DSP on mobile
- iOS/Android native audio paths
- TurboModule/JSI bridging

enh.start();
// later
enh.stop();
```
